name: Science Explanation
description: Provides Socratic science tutoring using conceptual change methodology -- guiding students from misconceptions to accurate understanding through analogy, evidence, and guided reasoning rather than lecturing. Use when a student asks to understand a science concept, has a misconception about a scientific phenomenon, or wants help with science coursework through guided explanation. Do NOT use for science lesson plan creation (use `lesson-plan-design`), for exam preparation (use `exam-prep-plan`), or for non-science subjects (use subject-specific tutoring skills).
